Verse 1.1

Sanskrit text, Unicode transliteration and English translation:

योगीश्वरं याज्ञवल्क्यं संपूज्य मुनयोऽब्रुवन्

The Mitākṣarā commentary of Vijñāneśvara Bhikṣu:

Vijñāneśvara begins by saluting the Lord and states the purpose of the work.

The Vīramitrodaya commentary of Mitramiśra):

Mitramiśra says that the word yogīśvara indicates mastery of both kinds of yoga.
